title: Keel runs on its own practice
outcome: Every rule keel will ship is already holding on keel: phases own status, the roadmap is checked, lessons are shapes, and the conductor can walk the plan.

title: Start a project in one command
outcome: From an empty directory, keel init produces a repo whose check passes, whose roadmap renders, and that an agent can conduct the same day.

title: The fleet stays current
outcome: Existing projects come under keel without losing what is theirs, and a practice change reaches every one of them as a reviewed pull request.

title: Lessons come home
outcome: A lesson learned in any project, or a practice improved upstream, reaches keel, is decided by a person, and ships to the rest of the fleet.

title: The night shift keeps it working
outcome: Without anyone remembering, each project is measured nightly, dependencies move in reviewed lanes, and anything red reaches a person.

title: Keel knows whether it helps
outcome: Keel can show, with numbers across the fleet, whether projects it manages ship more and break less, and what conducting costs.
